item.title: Joining a Gym
item.summary: Nilufar compares two gym memberships, asks about classes and chooses the one that fits her working hours.
item.transcript_text:
Timur: Hi there, welcome to City Fit. Are you interested in joining?
Nilufar: Yes, I am. Can you tell me about the memberships?
Timur: Sure. We have two options. The basic one is two hundred thousand som a month, and you can come from seven in the morning until four in the afternoon.
Nilufar: Hmm, I work until five, so that's no good for me.
Timur: Then the full membership is better. It's three hundred thousand a month, and you can come any time from six in the morning to eleven at night. It also includes group classes.
Nilufar: What kind of classes do you have?
Timur: Yoga on Monday and Wednesday evenings, and a dance class on Saturday mornings.
Nilufar: Oh, I'd love to try yoga. Do I need to bring anything?
Timur: Just comfortable clothes and a towel. We have mats here.
Nilufar: Great. I'll take the full membership, please.
